title: AI-Enabled Pathology Model for Precision Diagnosis and Treatment
summary: Huawei reports that RuiPath reduced pathology-review time at Ruijin Hospital, including initial review from 20–40 to 10–15 minutes per patient.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Ruijin Hospital and Huawei unveiled RuiPath on 18 February 2025, and the hospital said that its development took around three years. The RuiPath pathology pilot covers 11 subspecialties at Ruijin Hospital. In its submission to the International Telecommunication Union, current as of June 2025, Huawei reports that review and report preparation became shorter. Huawei reports that physicians doing the initial review now spend 10–15 minutes per patient with AI-assisted image analysis and report editing, down from 20–40 minutes. Huawei also claims benefits in model accuracy and data engineering. Some of its percentage and timing statements differ. No patient-specific treatment improvement is reported. Xinhua reported on 31 August 2026 that Ruijin Hospital and Huawei Cloud had released RuiPath 2.0. It reported that more than 90 hospitals in China use RuiPath. No independent study of its effect on review times has been published.
purpose: Assist pathology analysis and reduce report-preparation work.

data.answer:
Huawei reports that RuiPath reduced pathology-review time at Ruijin Hospital, including initial review from 20–40 to 10–15 minutes per patient.

The submission describes a reduction from 40 to 15 minutes as a 75% efficiency improvement, although the elapsed-time reduction is 62.5%. It also supplies different task-specific ranges. These measures need defined baselines, and faster review does not establish improved diagnosis or treatment.

The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.
